value.rationale: The fibbinary set arises canonically as the odd-index support of a classical proportional binomial family. Its four-point additive energy measures full two-sum representation collisions, not determined by the Fibonacci size or arithmetic-progression count. The exact fifth-order generating function and Perron growth lead to a quantitative near-critical analytic fact: the limiting golden-mean self-convolution has grid correlation dimension about 0.953906<1 and no L2 density despite the factor support dimension log(phi)/log(2)>1/2. This structural consequence motivates the precise invariant independently of routine enumeration. The argument does not claim absolute continuity or singularity.
